precommit_intent: This manifest must be committed and pushed to draft PR #5229 before its target stream is constructed or either factor-base arm is executed.

stream_derivation.construction: SHA-256(domain || 0x00 || master_seed || 0x00 || stream_name || 0x00 || u64be(index)); reduce the big-endian digest modulo the requested range

comparison.cardinality_contract: 34 abscissae and 68 signed points in both arms
comparison.retained_side: canonical elliptic-negation quotient of the complete unordered signed three-sum multiset
comparison.streamed_side: complete unordered signed two-sum multiset regenerated in blocks per target and discarded after probing
comparison.round_order: dickson-torus,ordinary-small-x on even rounds; reversed on odd rounds
comparison.primary_evidence: full-scan deterministic operation vectors on common random targets
comparison.secondary_evidence: first-hit counts and local non-isolated producer wall diagnostics

tuning_disclosure.block_size_source: fixed by the frozen protocol before execution

environment.isolation: none; exact counts are primary and local wall time is only a producer diagnostic
